Name: Fake flood at the port
Description: The port water level sensor reports 180 cm while the true physical level remains normal at 40 cm.
Expected: Twin: At tick 5, PRT-WLV-01 reports 180.0 while actual_value remains 40.0. It continues to report its actual simulated input; if quarantined, registry status becomes RESTRICTED.
Expected: Guardian: The deterministic scenario adapter marks the inconsistent reading UNTRUSTED at the same simulation tick (within the 10-second target), then quarantines PRT-WLV-01.
Expected: Brain: Checks the UNTRUSTED verdict, refuses the flood response, and records the reason. No pump or valve command is dispatched.
How to verify: Follow the shared correlation_id from Twin reading to Guardian verdict, Brain refusal, and actuator NOT_DISPATCHED event in the live terminal timeline and logs/t5-*.log.
